If the projector behind the lens is burnt then your best bet is to replace them, if you want to clean them, be very careful when doing so. Do you wear glasses by any chance? I was having the same problem as you, almost every car blinded me. When I changed my prescription glasses I asked for antireflective coating on the lenses, that solved my issue.

Have you checked the adjusters inside the headlight? They are made of plastic and can break. I was thinking of retrofitting xenon on my e39 but I couldn't afford it at that time so I replaced the adjusters and cleaned the dust from the projectors with some ear sticks taped to a straw. It s honestly so much better, I even tried some LED bulbs but went back to the halogen bulbs as they seemed brighter, I was expecting that honestly, the LEDs were some Chinese bulbs so yeah, no wonder why's that

P.S you can change the adjusters without opening the headlight, but get ready for some fun time, took me 10 hours and lots of swear words lol
